# Guide screenshots

These ten original 1280 × 800 PNGs show TabTools 4.0.2 loaded from PR19 source
commit `0f1507736ecf23d89044a9d35cdd99e033c3191f` in Google Chrome
153.0.8010.52 stable. They were captured on 21 September 2026 with Cua.ai's
Sandbox SDK `screen.screenshot()` using a disposable browser session.

Only Google Chrome is visible. The enlarged cursor uses the Windows Aero XL
shape, white fill and an approximately 3 px black outline, rendered live before
capture. The screenshot pixels have not been edited, cropped or recompressed.

- `close-site-*`: close three YouTube tabs, leaving two Wikipedia tabs and Google;
  also show the popup suggestion and hostname-entry alternatives.
- `duplicates-*`: remove two repeated YouTube homepage tabs, reducing eight tabs
  to six, with the result and Undo visible.
- `sort-*`: arrange six tabs as YouTube ×3, Wikipedia ×2 and Google ×1.

The browser session used public, signed-out pages. These demonstrate the PR's
unpacked extension, not a separately verified store release. Website names and
logos shown in Chrome belong to their respective owners.
